evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy https://github.com/example/low-score-monorepo 。根目录是工具包，但 packages/docs 是一个可以构建的文档站点。
evals.expected_output: Runs the opening impossibility judgment, treats the repository as a source boundary, warns on a low score without stopping, and selects the project-backed docs application.

assertions.name: low-score-continues
assertions.description: A score below 4 produces a warning and does not itself stop the pipeline.

assertions.name: finds-child-application
assertions.description: Inspects child applications and selects the repository-backed docs site instead of assuming the root is the only deployable unit.

assertions.name: writes-current-analysis
assertions.description: Writes schema-valid analysis.json with honest open-vocabulary facts and no separate entry-classifier artifact.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy https://github.com/example/exact-official-app 。这是默认分支的干净 fresh clone，官方 catalog 中只有一个 spec.gitRepo 精确匹配。
evals.expected_output: Refreshes and verifies the official catalog, copies the exact official YAML verbatim, skips source image/build/template generation, writes empty official-route aggregate build artifacts, validates, and finishes.

assertions.name: verified-exact-only
assertions.description: Fast path requires one exact spec.gitRepo match from a refreshed verified official catalog.

assertions.name: copies-verbatim
assertions.description: Copies the selected official index.yaml verbatim and does not regenerate it.

assertions.name: stable-official-artifacts
assertions.description: Writes route=official-template build-request.json with no services and a skipped aggregate build-result.json.

assertions.name: prepare-only-finish
assertions.description: Validates the handoff and stops without cloud deployment or runtime verification.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 当前 workspace。官方 catalog 有精确匹配，但当前是 feature 分支而且存在本地源代码修改。
evals.expected_output: Records the exact match for provenance but disables official reuse and continues the standard current-source pipeline.

assertions.name: protects-current-intent
assertions.description: Does not replace custom-branch or locally modified source with official YAML.

assertions.name: decision-driven-route
assertions.description: Reads template-references.json decision.route instead of inferring the route from file existence.

assertions.name: no-similar-reference-flow
assertions.description: Does not select or consume a structurally similar catalog template.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 一个 Compose 项目：frontend 有可验证的公开 digest，api 只有 build，postgres 要转换为 KubeBlocks，worker 也只有 build。
evals.expected_output: Preserves the full topology, creates one aggregate standard build request for frontend/api/worker but not the managed database container, reuses frontend, builds api and worker independently, and aggregates results.

assertions.name: complete-topology
assertions.description: Retains frontend, API, database capability, and worker rather than stopping after the first image.

assertions.name: aggregate-request
assertions.description: Writes one version 2.0 build-request.json containing every final container service with unique artifact keys.

assertions.name: managed-db-not-built
assertions.description: Keeps PostgreSQL topology for KubeBlocks conversion without building the source database container.

assertions.name: aggregate-result
assertions.description: Records reused and independently built services in one completed build-result.json.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy https://github.com/example/private-source-app 。没有 Docker daemon，需要构建镜像；环境已经注入 GITHUB_TOKEN、kubeconfig 和 VersityGW 配置。
evals.expected_output: Uses the injected token and current sandbox Kubernetes identity, packages the local context to VersityGW, builds with Kaniko, pushes GHCR, and records the immutable digest.

assertions.name: no-browser-auth
assertions.description: Does not start browser authentication or ask the user to log in to GitHub or Sealos.

assertions.name: current-sandbox-identity
assertions.description: Uses the current namespace, kubeconfig, and service account without region/workspace selection or admin fallback.

assertions.name: kaniko-build
assertions.description: Uses the k8s-kaniko-job path and never requires a Docker daemon.

assertions.name: immutable-result
assertions.description: Extracts Kaniko's digest and records a linux/amd64 immutable image ref.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 一个多服务项目。api 的 Kaniko 构建因 Dockerfile COPY 路径错误失败，web 已经成功。
evals.expected_output: Classifies an api build-plan failure, minimally repairs only api through Phase 3, retries it within the per-service limit, and does not rebuild web.

assertions.name: service-scoped-repair
assertions.description: Routes only the failed api service through the Phase 4 to Phase 3 repair loop.

assertions.name: bounded-retries
assertions.description: Limits build-plan repairs to three attempts for the failing service.

assertions.name: preserves-successes
assertions.description: Does not rerun or rewrite services that already succeeded.

assertions.name: failure-has-no-image
assertions.description: A failed result does not expose a deployable digest.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 一个需要构建的应用。推送到 GHCR 后匿名 pull 返回 403。
evals.expected_output: Keeps the digest, records ghcr_secret_required, adds only an app-scoped imagePullSecrets reference to the affected workload, and leaves credential materialization downstream.

assertions.name: records-private-pull
assertions.description: Records ghcr_secret_required while retaining the immutable built image.

assertions.name: reference-only
assertions.description: Template contains the affected workload imagePullSecrets reference using defaults.app_name.

assertions.name: no-inline-credentials
assertions.description: Template and delivery artifacts contain no Docker config, registry Secret payload, token, username, or password.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 一个应用需要 ADMIN_PASSWORD、SMTP_PASSWORD 和可选 LOG_LEVEL。
evals.expected_output: Classifies configuration accurately, retains required/optional Template inputs, validates string defaults, and does not collect or resolve values in the prepare workflow.

assertions.name: classifies-env-vars
assertions.description: Records required, auto, and optional environment variable categories from project evidence.

assertions.name: keeps-template-inputs
assertions.description: Preserves required and optional values as Template inputs/defaults for the downstream system.

assertions.name: no-interactive-config
assertions.description: Does not run the user-facing interactive configuration phase.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 一个 Helm 项目，包含 Deployment、worker、Service、Ingress、ConfigMap、RBAC 和一个受支持数据库。
evals.expected_output: Renders Helm in a temporary copy, preserves resource/container identity, uses the Kubernetes adapter directly, accounts for every source resource, and validates topology evidence.

assertions.name: safe-helm-render
assertions.description: Uses Helm 3 in a temporary chart copy with no helm install and no source mutation.

assertions.name: kubernetes-adapter
assertions.description: Uses kubernetes_to_template.py on rendered.yaml rather than collapsing topology into Compose.

assertions.name: resource-accounting
assertions.description: Writes resource-map.json and validator-only topology evidence with no silently dropped resources.

assertions.name: database-semantics
assertions.description: Uses KubeBlocks only if initialization and runtime semantics are preserved, otherwise retains an annotated raw fallback.

evals.prompt: /sealos-deploy 完成镜像和模板准备后，请直接把它部署到云端并确认 URL。
evals.expected_output: Finishes the validated Brain delivery artifacts but explicitly stops before deployment because downstream owns deployment and runtime feedback.

assertions.name: complete-delivery
assertions.description: Writes analysis, template references, aggregate build request/result, Template YAML, and delivery manifest.

assertions.name: cross-validates
assertions.description: Requires aligned routes, services, immutable images, pull-Secret references, existing manifest paths, and a passing YAML quality gate.

assertions.name: does-not-deploy
assertions.description: Does not call Sealos auth, choose region/workspace, invoke the Template API, apply final YAML, or write deployment state.

assertions.name: honest-final-status
assertions.description: Reports preparation complete and does not claim that the application is running or has a verified URL.
